title: 第7章 兄弟
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “那估计要过年放假才能回。”刘宇宁没想到李婶还要追着想介绍，也没好意思拒绝，只能委婉地表示自己没有时间。“这样啊……”还要等大半年，李婶明显有些遗憾，“那我带人到镇上去找你？”“宇宁刚回来，带人去单位见，估计影响不好。”王秀菊总算找到机会插话。“再说了，他们单位里，说不定也有没结婚的姑娘……”“对啊，在单位找个一块上班的媳妇，两个人都有工作，这辈子都不用种地了，多好。”吴婶一脸艳羡，话里话外，都让李婶别想动那个心思了。她要介绍的姑娘，大概就是娘家的外甥女吧？就冲李婶这模样，她外甥女又能好看到哪里去？还敢拿来跟徐喜弟比！真是癞蛤蟆想天鹅屁吃。躲在树后的徐喜弟十分认同地点点头，刘宇宁就该找个有文化，在单位工作的媳妇，郎才女貌，天作之合。都熬出头了，自然要娶个同样有本事的媳妇，未来无可限量！光想想就美滋滋的。“喜弟，你吃饭了吗？”刘烨的声音冷不丁在身后不远处响起，这是农村人见面的标准问候。徐喜弟吓得差点蹦起来。转身就看到刘烨挑着两捆巨大的牛草，站在岔路口。两人虽然是那种特殊的关系，也连续办了两回事，可徐喜弟还是害怕遇见他。一来脸皮薄心里觉得尴尬，二来怕将来被他缠上。说到底是见不得光的事，大家还是保持距离，各自烂在肚子里比较好。“叔，你今天割草这么晚……”应完这一句，徐喜弟想咬断自己的舌头。可不是这么晚嘛，他一大早先给张国海家割了三天的猪菜，然后才去割的牛草！这是体谅她夜里辛苦，早上起不来床……想到这，徐喜弟老脸一红，她也不听瓜了，低着头就匆匆进村。刘烨看着她的远去的背影，又往热闹的溪边望了望。徐喜弟不合群，他知道，因为被亲生父母抛弃，让范金花捡回来当童养媳，在十里八乡还是独一份。所以村里的老婶子们，从小就看不起她，甚至背后常拿她来议论。尤其张国海家那个情况，以前还在生产队就被孤立排挤，后来分地的时候，家里还多个人口多占份地，让很多人心里不满。抓了抓头，刘烨蹦着担子准备跟着进村。忽然听到溪边传来一个久别的声音。“婶，我就先回家了。”他再次朝那边望过去，就看到身材挺拔的刘宇宁，抱着一团湿漉漉的薄膜往他这边走来。“宇宁？你回来了？！”刘烨忍不住远远就喊了一声，语气里都是惊讶。刘宇宁看到刘烨，连忙快步迎上去。“烨哥，你割草呢。”两人边聊边往村里走。“你变化可真大，一表人才啊！”刘烨忍不住惊叹。嘿嘿……刘宇宁咧嘴就笑纳了这声赞美。“今天刚回来的吗？”刘烨随口一问。“前天下午就回到了。”“前天……”刘烨突然脚步一顿，定定看向他，“都回来两天了，怎么也不见上家里坐坐。”“呃……”刘宇宁有点不好意思，确实是他不应该，“这两天忙着给家里补屋瓦，我没在，漏雨漏了好半年。”“那今晚上我家里坐坐？哥家没什么好菜，但是酿了几斤野果酒，一直没舍得喝……”刘烨盛情邀请。刘宇宁想了想，只能回道，“我等会儿上你家聊聊，晚上我老表他们过来，酒就留着咱们下次喝。”“那明天晚上？”“明天……”“明天不行，那后天总可以了吧？”“后天……”刘烨还是第一次见他这么婆婆妈妈的，从前可不这样。他比他只大了十一岁，两人从前又经常跟张永福和徐喜弟一起玩，所以关系也很好。可是他出去这么多年，好不容易回来一趟，自己邀请他上家里，还犹犹豫豫的。“你这次回来待几天？总能抽一个晚上跟哥喝一杯吧？”刘烨明显觉得自己被冷落了，有些不高兴。“还回部队吗？”“不回了，过两天准备去镇上的单位报到，在那里工作。”刘宇宁如实回答。“出息了啊，难怪不待见哥了。”刘烨语气有些酸，“看来我的果酒，是入不了你的眼了。”说完，他就转头蹦着担子进村。刘宇宁停在原地，沉思了一会儿，最后快步追上去。“哥，那明天晚上我上你家，尝一尝你的果酒。下次可就得等到过年了。”“是我不对，咱们关系这么好，回来两天应该最先去看你的。”刘烨得了这话，心里总算舒服了，回头朝他咧嘴憨笑。“这还差不多！”两人边走边聊，话题很快就引到了终身大事上。“宇宁，你也二十四了吧？有对象没？”“还没呢，在部队几年，狗都是公的，上哪儿找对象去。”“你怎么不在部队混个官当，还回来这穷乡僻壤的，读那么多书可惜了。”刘烨由衷感叹。“心里总想为家乡做点什么，根在这，牵挂在这，我走不远。”刘烨又定住脚步，怔怔看着他，“为家乡做贡献？好，好，好！是咱村的好儿郎！”刘宇宁笑了笑，“略尽微薄之力吧。”两人相视一笑，话题重新回到终身大事上。“看来你爸妈很快就能跟着你享清福了，你在单位，再找个一起工作的媳妇，把他俩接过去给你们带孩子。”刘烨开始憧憬这个堂侄的美好生活。“看缘分吧，在单位工作的姑娘，可未必能看上我这样泥腿子出身的汉子。”刘宇宁似乎没有那么乐观，忽然话题一转。“烨哥，你呢？这个年纪了，还是一个人。”提到这个，刘烨咧一口白牙，满不在意笑道。“我？我找不到啊！你看整条村，最穷的就是我，又没有人帮衬，谁愿意嫁我？”“烨哥，现在小弟我日子好了，你要是娶妻缺钱，跟我说……”刘宇宁知道他的情况，想了想，“明天我先给你拿点，你找媒人去远一点的村子找找。彩礼的事别担心，不管多少我来掏。”
content_en: "Then I probably won't be able to come back until the Chinese New Year holiday." Liu Yuning didn't expect that Aunt Li would still want to introduce her, and he was too embarrassed to refuse, so he could only express politely that he didn't have time."Is that so..." Aunt Li was obviously a little regretful about having to wait for more than half a year, "Then I will take people to the town to find you?" "Yuning just came back and took people to meet at the work. I guess the impact will not be good." Wang Xiuju finally found a chance to interject."Besides, there might be unmarried girls in their workplace..." "Yes, find a wife who works together in the workplace. Both of us have jobs, and we don't have to farm for the rest of our lives. That would be great." Aunt Wu looked envious, and her words made Aunt Li stop thinking about that.The girl she wants to introduce is probably her mother's niece, right?With Aunt Li looking like this, how could her niece be so good at seeing her?How dare you compare it with Xu Xidi!It's really a toad that wants to eat the swan's fart.Xu Xidi, who was hiding behind a tree, nodded in agreement. Liu Yuning should find a wife who is educated and works in the workplace. She is talented and beautiful, a match made in heaven.Now that I have made it through life, I naturally want to marry a daughter-in-law who is equally capable. The future is limitless!Just thinking about it makes me happy."Brother happy, have you eaten?" Liu Ye's voice sounded suddenly not far behind him. This was a standard greeting for rural people when they met.Xu Xidi was so frightened that he almost jumped up.When he turned around, he saw Liu Ye standing at the fork in the road carrying two huge bundles of cow grass.Although the two had a special relationship and had two affairs in a row, Xu Xidi was still afraid of meeting him.Firstly, I felt embarrassed because I was thin-skinned, and secondly, I was afraid that I would be entangled with him in the future.After all, it's a shady matter, so it's better for everyone to keep a distance and rot in their own stomachs."Uncle, you cut the grass so late today..." After saying this, Xu Xidi wanted to bite off his tongue.It's not so late. He cut pig vegetables for Zhang Guohai's family for three days early in the morning, and then went to cut cow grass!This was to understand that she had a hard night and couldn't get out of bed in the morning... Thinking of this, Xu Xidi blushed, and she stopped listening and hurried into the village with her head lowered.Liu Ye looked at her retreating back and then looked towards the lively stream.Xu Xidi is not a social person. He knows that because he was abandoned by his biological parents and let Fan Jinhua take her back as a child bride, he is still the only one in the world.Therefore, the old aunts in the village have looked down on her since she was a child, and often even talk about her behind her back.Especially in the case of Zhang Guohai's family, they were isolated and marginalized when they were still in the production team. Later, when the land was divided, there were multiple people in the family occupying the land, which made many people feel dissatisfied.After scratching his head, Liu Ye picked up the burden and prepared to follow him into the village.Suddenly I heard a long-lost voice coming from the stream."Aunt, I'm going home first." He looked over there again and saw the tall and tall Liu Yuning walking towards him holding a ball of wet film."Yuning? Are you back?!" Liu Ye couldn't help but shouted from a distance, with surprise in his tone.When Liu Yuning saw Liu Ye, he hurried up to meet him."Brother Ye, you are cutting the grass." The two of them walked towards the village while chatting."You have changed so much, you are such a talented person!" Liu Ye couldn't help but marvel.Hehe... Liu Yuning grinned and accepted the compliment."Did you just come back today?" Liu Ye asked casually."I came back the day before yesterday in the afternoon." "The day before yesterday..." Liu Ye suddenly stopped and looked at him, "I've been back for two days and I haven't come back to my house." "Uh..." Liu Yuning was a little embarrassed. He really shouldn't."I've been busy repairing roof tiles at home these past two days. I wasn't here, and the water leaked for half a year." "Why don't you come to my house tonight? My brother's house doesn't have any good food, but he brewed a few kilograms of wild fruit wine, and I haven't been willing to drink it..." Liu Ye invited him warmly.Liu Yuning thought for a while and could only reply, "I'll go to your house later and have a chat. My old cousin and his friends will come over tonight, and we'll save the wine for next time." "What about tomorrow night?" "Tomorrow..." "If you can't do it tomorrow, then the day after tomorrow is okay, right?" "The day after tomorrow..." This was the first time Liu Ye had seen such a mother-in-law like him. It had not been like this before.He is only eleven years older than him, and the two used to play together with Zhang Yongfu and Xu Xidi, so they have a good relationship.But he had been away for so many years, and when he finally came back, he still hesitated to invite him to his home."How many days will you be back this time? You can always find one night to have a drink with me, right?" Liu Ye obviously felt that he had been left out and was a little unhappy."Return to the army?" "Not going back. In two days, I will report to the unit in the town and work there." Liu Yuning answered truthfully."You are so promising. No wonder you don't want to see me anymore." Liu Ye said in a sour tone, "It seems that my fruit wine can't get into your eyes." After saying that, he turned around and walked into the village with his load.Liu Yuning stopped where he was, pondered for a while, and finally quickly caught up with him."Brother, I'll go to your house tomorrow night and have a taste of your fruit wine. I'll have to wait until the Chinese New Year next time." "It's my fault. We have such a good relationship. I should be the first to visit you after two days back." Liu Ye finally felt comfortable after hearing this, and turned around and grinned at him."That's pretty much it!" The two of them were walking and chatting, and the topic soon turned to life-long events."Yuning, are you twenty-four now? Do you have a partner?" "Not yet. After a few years in the army, dogs are all male. Where can I find a partner?" "Why don't you become an official in the army and come back to this remote country? It's a pity to read so many books." Liu Ye sighed sincerely."I always want to do something for my hometown. My roots are here and my concerns are here. I can't go far." Liu Ye stopped and looked at him blankly, "Contribute to my hometown? Okay, okay, okay! He is a good son of our village!" Liu Yuning smiled and said, "Let's do our best." The two looked at each other and smiled, and the conversation returned to life-long events."It seems that your parents will be able to live happily with you soon. When you are at work, find a wife who works together and take them over to take care of your children." Liu Ye began to long for the beautiful life of this cousin."It depends on fate. Girls who work in the workplace may not be able to like a man with a mud-legged background like me." Liu Yuning didn't seem so optimistic, and suddenly the topic changed."Brother Ye, what about you? At this age, you are still alone." Speaking of this, Liu Ye bared his white teeth and smiled nonchalantly."Me? I can't find it! Look at the whole village, I am the poorest, and there is no one to help, who is willing to marry me?" "Brother Ye, my life is better now. If you are short of money to get a wife, tell me..." Liu Yuning knew his situation and thought about it, "I will get you some tomorrow, and you can find a matchmaker in a village farther away. Don't worry about the bride price, no matter how much it is, I will pay for it."
